bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
P=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
SQL="SELECT 'TOPIC_STATE='||state||' COUNT='||count(*) FROM topic_dm_entry_pins GROUP BY state ORDER BY state; SELECT 'PANEL_STATE='||state||' COUNT='||count(*) FROM board_menu_panels WHERE panel_type='posting' GROUP BY state ORDER BY state; SELECT 'NEEDS_RECONCILE_TOPIC='||chat_id||':'||message_thread_id||':'||COALESCE(message_id::text,'NULL') FROM topic_dm_entry_pins WHERE state='needs_reconcile' ORDER BY chat_id,message_thread_id LIMIT 40;"
RESULT=$(docker compose -p deploy -f "$P/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" exec -T postgres psql -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "$SQL" 2>&1) || exit 32
gh issue comment 7 --repo seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot --body "$(printf 'POSTING_MENU_AFTER_APPLY_STATES_20261113\n%s' "$RESULT")" >/dev/null || exit 33
echo POSTING_MENU_STATE_DIAGNOSTICS_RECORDED
